Windows Setup helper (SlateSetup.exe)

This package is a Windows install helper only. It downloads and builds
Sam Wasserman's Slate so Windows users can run his application more easily.

It is NOT:
  - a fork of Slate presented as a new product
  - written by Sam Wasserman
  - an official Wasserman Productions release

It IS:
  - a separate helper tool
  - intended to install HIS software on Windows
  - required to keep Sam's authorship and license visible

Support and credit for Slate itself:
  https://github.com/wassermanproductions/slate
  https://ko-fi.com/samwasserman
